senses.gloss: m. (<cite ref="O01678"><he>סָרַר</he></cite>), corresp. to b. h. <cite ref="P01377"><he>עֵרֶךְ</he></cite>,

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">Gen. R. s. 32</cite> <he>סִידּוּרוֹ של עולם</he> the natural order, v. <cite ref="O00658"><he>סִילּוֹן</he> II</cite>.
Y. Meg. IV, 75ᵃ bot. שהיא סִדּוּרוֹ של יום (not סדורה) for this (the section of Amalek) is the order of the day.—[In later Hebr. ס׳ = ס׳ תפלה, the order of prayers, Prayerbook.]

senses.gloss: piling up, putting in order, esp. on the altar, the golden table &c., opp. סילוק, removal.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 24b:6">Yoma 24ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ בזיכין</he> the putting (on the show-bread) of the frankincense from the vessels; <he>ס׳ איברים</he> the offering of the sacrificial parts.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 11:6">Men. XI, 6</cite> <he>ס׳ קנים</he> the arrangement of the tubes for the show-bread.
<cite ref="Menachot 29a">Ib. 29ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>סילוקו כסִידּוּרוֹ</he> when it (the show-bread) was removed, it was as fresh as when it was put on; a. fr.

senses.gloss: [that which is arranged before a person,] offering, present.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:4">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> <he>טלו סִדּוּרוֹ</he> take what he has brought as his tribute.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> <he>ס׳ של דוב</he> the portions (of honey) designated for the bear (in the vivarium).

senses.gloss: (= עֵרֶךְ) determination of a man’s obligation (to the sanctuary &c.) based upon his financial ability (v. סָדַר Pi. 2); exemption from seizure.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 113b:6">B. Mets. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>עיקר ס׳ בערכין כתיב</he> the original exemption law is stated with reference to vows (<cite ref="Leviticus 27:8">Lev. XXVII, 8</cite>).
Y. Naz. II, 51ᵈ bot. סִידּוּרוֹ עלי וכ׳ if one said (pointing to a person), ‘I vow his siddur’ (instead of ערכו), he must pay his value according to his age.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:15">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 15</cite> <he>הס׳ והסדן וכ׳</he> the net and the block of the mill, if made of metal &c.—Sifra Metsorʿa, Zabim, Par. 1, ch. II, v. <cite ref="O01551"><he>סָרוּד</he></cite>.
